reviews.author: AbduRrhman Saber
reviews.text: Fast see, effective, and affordable price. I called them for battery change it all done within 10-15 minutes to my location with only 350 aed. plus 1 year warranty. I strongly recommend them for such services and other car services. big thanks

reviews.author: Mohammed Miah
reviews.text:
I visited this place a few weeks ago to get the upholstery for the sunroof replaced on my Audi A7. What I liked about this place is that they were honest with the work.

Other places tried to get me to change the fabric for my whole car roof so that they could charge me more!

Hani accessories knew what they were doing, they took my sunroof off very quickly, changed the fabric and replaced it just as quick. I decided to write my review a few weeks later to see if the quality will be maintained and it has. Their prices were very fair and I even bought some Bosch wiper blades for the car at a very competitive price.

You have earned a loyal customer and now I will only be using Hani Accessories for my car needs. I have already recommended this place to my friends and they know who to go to in the future for their car needs.

Thank you for delivering honest, outstanding work. Honesty in business is rare to find these days but it's what will make us become returning customers. I wish other businesses were more like this.

reviews.author: Lys Grli (Ilmak)
reviews.text:
Exceptional Service at HANI Car Accessories!

We had an amazing experience with HANI car accessories! The team Mehdi and Abolfazl was incredibly professional and knew exactly what they were doing. They replaced our old car radio with a brand new one, and the entire process was smooth, efficient, and done with great attention to detail.

From the moment we walked in, Mehdi made us feel welcome and confident in their work. They handled everything with care, explained the steps, and ensured the new system was working perfectly before we left. We were especially impressed by their expertise and how clean and precise the installation was.

Highly recommend HANI to anyone looking for top-notch car accessory services. Thank you for the outstanding work!
